limitations: Only N=3 and M=2, infinite well-mixed deterministic replicator
No assertion about stable cycles or global basins
Equivalent unindexed prior derivations remain a possible originality risk
scientific_integrity: One exact theorem on locally asymptotically stable equilibria of the three-player quorum-protection replicator, with an algebraic Jacobian sign obstruction and a rational sharpness witness. Arithmetic checks are supplementary, not proofs by enumeration.
title: Sharp three-attractor bound at the smallest quorum-protection group
